The Science Based Targets initiative approved Mondi's science-based targets in 2019.
Mondi's science-based targets cover more than 95% of the Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions from Mondi's pulp and paper mills, including emissions associated with energy sales.
Approximately 4% of Mondi's total greenhouse gas emissions were excluded from the science-based targets.
The excluded emissions principally comprised Scope 1 emissions from converting operations, mobile transportation, waste-related emissions, ozone-depleting substances and additional sources.
